ReadyState.summary.en: The `ReadyState` describe the state of a `WebSocket` connection.

ReadyState.CLOSED.summary.en: The connection is closed or couldn't be opened.
ReadyState.CLOSED.summary.text: 连接已关闭或无法打开。

ReadyState.CLOSING.summary.en: The connection is in the process of closing.

ReadyState.CONNECTING.summary.en: Socket has been created. The connection is not yet open.
ReadyState.CONNECTING.summary.text: Socket 已创建，连接尚未打开。

ReadyState.OPEN.summary.en: The connection is open and ready to communicate.
ReadyState.OPEN.summary.text: 连接已打开，可以进行通信。

WebSocket.remarks.en: This only works in environment that has `NativeModules.LynxWebSocketModule`.
WebSocket.remarks.text: 仅在存在 `NativeModules.LynxWebSocketModule` 的环境中可用。

WebSocket.constructor.params.url.en: The URL to which to connect; this should be the URL to which the WebSocket server will respond.
WebSocket.constructor.params.url.text: 要连接的 URL，即 WebSocket 服务器将响应的 URL。

WebSocket.constructor.params.protocols.en: Either a single protocol string or an array of protocol strings. If it is omitted, an empty array is used by default, i.e. `[]`.
WebSocket.constructor.params.protocols.text: 单个协议字符串或协议字符串数组。省略时默认使用空数组，即 `[]`。

WebSocket.constructor.params.options.text: 仅适用于 Lynx 的额外选项。

WebSocket.onclose.summary.en: onclose is the Web-style callback of [`WebSocket`](api:WebSocket).
WebSocket.onclose.summary.text: onclose 是 [`WebSocket`](api:WebSocket) 的 Web 风格回调。

WebSocket.onerror.summary.en: onerror is the Web-style callback of [`WebSocket`](api:WebSocket).
WebSocket.onerror.summary.text: onerror 是 [`WebSocket`](api:WebSocket) 的 Web 风格回调。

WebSocket.onmessage.summary.en: onmessage is the Web-style callback of [`WebSocket`](api:WebSocket).
WebSocket.onmessage.summary.text: onmessage 是 [`WebSocket`](api:WebSocket) 的 Web 风格回调。

WebSocket.onopen.summary.en: onopen is the Web-style callback of [`WebSocket`](api:WebSocket).
WebSocket.onopen.summary.text: onopen 是 [`WebSocket`](api:WebSocket) 的 Web 风格回调。

WebSocket.protocol.summary.en: The WebSocket.protocol read-only property returns the name of the sub-protocol the server selected.
WebSocket.protocol.summary.text: WebSocket.protocol 只读属性返回服务器所选子协议的名称。

WebSocket.readyState.summary.en: The `readyState` read-only property returns the current state of the [`WebSocket`](api:WebSocket) connection.
WebSocket.readyState.summary.text: `readyState` 只读属性返回 [`WebSocket`](api:WebSocket) 连接的当前状态。

WebSocket.url.summary.en: The `url` read-only property returns the URL of the [`WebSocket`](api:WebSocket) passed by the constructor.
WebSocket.url.summary.text: `url` 只读属性返回通过构造函数传入 [`WebSocket`](api:WebSocket) 的 URL。

WebSocket.addEventListener.summary.en: The `addEventListener()` method of the `EventTarget` interface sets up a function that will be called whenever the specified event is delivered to the target.
WebSocket.addEventListener.summary.text: `EventTarget` 接口的 `addEventListener()` 方法用于设置一个函数，每当指定事件派发到目标时都会调用该函数。

WebSocket.addEventListener.params.type.en: A case-sensitive string representing the event type to listen for.
WebSocket.addEventListener.params.type.text: 表示要监听的事件类型的字符串，区分大小写。

WebSocket.addEventListener.params.callba.en: The function that receives a notification. See [`EventMap`](api:@lynx-js/websocket#EventMap) for details of events.
WebSocket.addEventListener.params.callba.text: 接收通知的函数。事件详情参见 [`EventMap`](api:@lynx-js/websocket#EventMap)。

WebSocket.close.summary.en: The `close()` method closes the [`WebSocket`](api:WebSocket) connection or connection attempt, if any.
WebSocket.close.summary.text: `close()` 方法关闭 [`WebSocket`](api:WebSocket) 连接或正在进行的连接尝试（如有）。

WebSocket.close.remarks.en: If the connection is already [`CLOSED `](api:WebSocket.CLOSED), this method does nothing.
WebSocket.close.remarks.text: 如果连接已处于 [`CLOSED `](api:WebSocket.CLOSED) 状态，该方法不执行任何操作。

WebSocket.ping.summary.en: The `ping` method send an empty message to the server over the [`WebSocket`](api:WebSocket) connection.
WebSocket.ping.summary.text: `ping` 方法通过 [`WebSocket`](api:WebSocket) 连接向服务器发送一条空消息。

WebSocket.ping.remarks.en: It will throw an exception if you call `ping()` when the connection is in the [`CONNECTING `](api:WebSocket.CONNECTING) state. If you call `ping()` when the connection is in the [`CLOSING `](api:WebSocket.CLOSING) or [`CLOSED `](api:WebSocket.CLOSED) states, it will silently discard the data.
WebSocket.ping.remarks.text: 在连接处于 [`CONNECTING `](api:WebSocket.CONNECTING) 状态时调用 `ping()` 会抛出异常。在连接处于 [`CLOSING `](api:WebSocket.CLOSING) 或 [`CLOSED `](api:WebSocket.CLOSED) 状态时调用 `ping()`，数据会被静默丢弃。

WebSocket.removeEventListener.summary.en: The `removeEventListener()` method of the `EventTarget` interface removes an event listener from the WebSocket.
WebSocket.removeEventListener.summary.text: `EventTarget` 接口的 `removeEventListener()` 方法从 WebSocket 上移除一个事件监听器。

WebSocket.removeEventListener.params.typ.en: The type of event to stop listening for.
WebSocket.removeEventListener.params.typ.text: 要停止监听的事件类型。

WebSocket.removeEventListener.params.cal.en: The function to remove as an event listener.
WebSocket.removeEventListener.params.cal.text: 要移除的事件监听函数。

WebSocket.send.summary.en: The `send` method send the specified data to be transmitted to the server over the [`WebSocket`](api:WebSocket) connection.
WebSocket.send.summary.text: `send` 方法通过 [`WebSocket`](api:WebSocket) 连接将指定数据发送到服务器。

WebSocket.send.remarks.en: It will throw an exception if you call `send()` when the connection is in the [`CONNECTING `](api:WebSocket.CONNECTING) state. If you call `send()` when the connection is in the [`CLOSING `](api:WebSocket.CLOSING) or [`CLOSED `](api:WebSocket.CLOSED) states, it will silently discard the data.
WebSocket.send.remarks.text: 在连接处于 [`CONNECTING `](api:WebSocket.CONNECTING) 状态时调用 `send()` 会抛出异常。在连接处于 [`CLOSING `](api:WebSocket.CLOSING) 或 [`CLOSED `](api:WebSocket.CLOSED) 状态时调用 `send()`，数据会被静默丢弃。

WebSocket.send.params.data.en: The specified data to be transmitted.

Event.summary.en: An implementation of `Event` interface, that wraps a given event object.
Event.summary.text: `Event` 接口的实现，用于包装给定的事件对象。

EventMap.summary.en: The `EventMap` describe the events that [`WebSocket`](api:@lynx-js/websocket#WebSocket) may fire.
EventMap.summary.text: `EventMap` 描述 [`WebSocket`](api:@lynx-js/websocket#WebSocket) 可能触发的事件。
